title: SDW100 2025 Infopack — official archive
claims: The 2025 edition was held over the weekend of 14–15 June 2025, with a 30 hour limit and cut-offs at every aid station.
The 2025 infopack tells runners not to recce the first 7.2 miles around Matterley Estate and lists course records of Mark Perkins (M) 14:03:54 in 2014 and Bethan Male (F) 16:49:57 in 2022.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接抓取并读取 2025 届 infopack。recce 距离写 7.2 miles，与 2026/2027 的 5 miles 不同。
